title: A DEAD DEER IS A DEER, NOT A MAN
why: His note: deer becomes a human body, fix it. A shot deer left a meat container of type body, and that type drew the prone human figure. The container is now tagged a deer carcass and drawn as a deer lying on its side in the live deer art, with the old flat blob not drawn twice. Pillager and player bodies are unchanged.
now: A dead deer lies as a deer on its side instead of a human body.
